crossRefs.note: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

people.name: Libni
people.line: Grandson of Merari; grandson of Levi

people.name: Mahli
people.line: Son of Merari, grandson of Levi.

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

people.name: Shimei
people.line: Levite of the family of Merari.

people.name: Uzzah
people.line: Levite of the clan of Merari
